unsupported: This hub doesn't support model configuration yet. Update the server first.
intro: Each feature uses these settings the next time it runs; tasks already working aren't interrupted. Manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
no_purposes: The hub has no model uses to configure yet
saved: Saved; applies from the next run
conflict: The configuration was changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reload, then edit and save again.
effective_footer: A use's settings take priority over the defaults; a one-off choice in a session or task can still override them.
picker_hint_provider: Default means empty: this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit: Default means empty: inherit the setting from the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_provider_machine: Default means empty: this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit_machine: Default means empty: inherit the setting from the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
field_hint: Leave empty to inherit. Setting a model ID doesn't mean it has been checked with a real request.
save_note: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks.
save_note_plugin: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks. The voice model is Persona's default choice and doesn't change the extension's own provider or credentials.
